## Recording rules

- Record the actual command output or a concise result for T1 and T2.
- For T3, record the prompt topic, the agent used, and whether the response agreed with the repository.
- Describe any disagreement between members or agents and how Group B resolved it.
- A member is ready only when all three checks are recorded successfully on that member's own computer.
